title: Critique: as a hidden-variable model, the theory is nonlocal and conspiratorial

statements.text: Indrajit Sen builds a hidden-variable model of invariant set theory and finds that arguments about counterfactual measurements, nonlocality, non-commutativity and measurement independence fail in it. The model is superdeterministic, nonlocal and has an ontic quantum state, and superdeterminism is unlikely to solve the puzzle of the Bell correlations.

sources.quote: We further show that our model is not only superdeterministic but also nonlocal, with an ontic quantum state.
